card.name: Dragão do Trovão
card.summary: Descarte esta carta da mão. Na resolução, adicione à mão 1 ou 2 Dragões do Trovão do seu Deck e embaralhe.

textEvidence.text: Thunder Dragon activates an ignition effect in hand by discarding itself as cost. At least one copy in the controller’s Deck is required. At resolution choose one or two copies still available and add them from Deck to hand, reveal the searched identity and shuffle the remainder. It does not draw cards or target, is not once per turn, and cannot activate from the field. Skill Drain on the field cannot negate this hand effect.

card.name: Dragão do Trovão de Duas Cabeças
card.summary: Fusão de dois Dragões do Trovão. Não possui efeito.

textEvidence.text: Twin-Headed Thunder Dragon is a non-Effect LIGHT Thunder Fusion Monster. The complete printed recipe names Thunder Dragon twice: the two materials must be different physical cards. One legal Fusion substitute may replace only one of the two named monsters. Polymerization, Extra Deck placement, material ownership and proper Fusion Summon status follow the normal Fusion procedure. No secondary effect is printed.
